newsitem.title: SOUTH AFRICA: S.African court jails state assassin for life.
newsitem.headline: S.African court jails state assassin for life.

text.p: A South African judge on Wednesday jailed apartheid assassin Eugene de Kock for a total of more than 200 years, including two life terms, for murder, fraud and scores of lesser crimes.
"Your actions were chilling and calculated. These sentences will reflect the revulsion of the community at the deeds," Judge Willem van der Merwe said.

De Kock, a former police colonel, was found guilty in August of six murders and a range of other crimes including conspiracy to murder, attempted murder, culpable homicide, fraud, assault, and illegal possession of arms and ammunition.
The judge said he was repelled by the neat, bespectacled 47-year-old career policeman who led a ruthless death squad unit that hunted down black liberation guerrillas.
"It is correct that his activities came from a certain time, to which we will never return. (However) these actions leave one with a chilling feeling... It fills a person with revulsion.
"With this sentencing a warning must be given that such actions will not be tolerated," the judge said at the end of the 20-month trial.
